in_hebrew.name: Lirio
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lirio הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word leirion, meaning lily. In Greek mythology, the lily was a symbol of purity and innocence. In Christianity, the lily is a symbol of the resurrection and the Virgin Mary.

in_greek.name: Lirio
in_greek.long_meaning: Lirio είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word leirion, meaning lily. In Greek mythology, the lily was a symbol of purity and innocence. In Christianity, the lily is a symbol of the resurrection and the Virgin Mary.

in_latin.name: Lirio
in_latin.long_meaning: Lirio est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word leirion, meaning lily. In Greek mythology, the lily was a symbol of purity and innocence. In Christianity, the lily is a symbol of the resurrection and the Virgin Mary.
